decisionMeaning: MKT-03. This manifest declares, for every sold connector, the pre-prompt / pre-tool / pre-model-output / model-stream / network interception points, the tamper posture and the outcome of the plugin-disabled, crashed, offline and large-binary-response conditions. A status of `enforced` requires a named real-host acceptance record in the row evidence. No connector has one (deploy/native/support-matrix.json carries an empty `acceptanceEvidence` array for every row), so no row is `enforced` and this file is not evidence that any interception point was accepted on a real host.

rows.reason: The connector registers no pre-prompt hook. hooks/hooks.json registers PreToolUse, PostToolUse and SessionStart only, and session-start.ts emits a user-facing systemMessage rather than inspecting or gating the prompt.
limitations: No prompt-submission interception is implemented for this connector, so nothing inspects or blocks user input before the model sees it.
No named real-host acceptance record exists for this connector, so the verdict path is source-declared only.
The hook always exits 0; a host that ignores the deny field, or a hook process killed before it writes a verdict, is not covered by this row.
No same-turn file/process/network side-effect observation exists on a real Claude host.
The host boundary is PostToolUse, so the tool has already executed; this is a tool-result boundary and not a refusal of the action.
Only the updatedToolOutput replacement path is claimed; a PostToolUse block without replacement still exposes the original result to the model.
No named real-host acceptance record exists, so same-turn model blocking is unproven.

rows.reason: No streaming or token-level interception module exists in this connector; it inspects complete tool responses only.
limitations: Provider streaming content that never traverses a tool result is not inspected at all.

rows.reason: No network egress interception is implemented for this connector. The MCP gateway is a separately deployed MCP transport boundary and is not part of the connector's interception surface.
limitations: MCP-07 remains partial: binary output, server-initiated requests and forced routing of direct upstream access are open.
Direct network access that never constructs a tool call is a documented bypass in deploy/native/support-matrix.json.

failureConditions.reason: A disabled or unregistered plugin means the host never starts the PreToolUse process, so no verdict is produced and the tool call proceeds.
limitations: This is the host's behaviour, not a connector guarantee; the connector cannot fail closed when it is not invoked.

failureConditions.reason: In-process errors are converted into an explicit deny, but the host's treatment of a hook process killed before it writes any verdict is not recorded by any evidence in this repository.
limitations: No real-host crash case has been run for this connector.
